providers.title: Subscriptions
providers.dropCollapsed_one: Only {{after}} of {{count}} node left after the last update; sing-box has dropped the rest. Check the subscription and update it again.
providers.dropCollapsed_other: Only {{after}} of {{count}} nodes left after the last update; sing-box has dropped the rest. Check the subscription and update it again.
providers.dropEmpty: No nodes left in the subscription. Check the subscription and its include and exclude filters, then update it again.

recovery.title: REALITY compatibility
recovery.stage: Enable hybrid key exchange in draft
recovery.blocked: Review the draft changes to this server before changing hybrid key exchange.
recovery.source: Compare the settings with a fresh server link. For a server from a subscription, refresh the subscription and test again.

states.suggested: Hybrid key exchange is off. If this REALITY server was recently updated, it may require this setting. The test does not identify the exact cause.
states.staged: Hybrid key exchange is enabled in the draft. Apply the draft, then test the server again.
states.applying: Confirm that you can still reach the router after applying.
states.ready: Setting applied. Test this server again.
states.no-response: Server did not respond after the change. The cause is still unknown.
states.probe-error: The test could not run. Try again when the core is available.
states.return-staged: The previous setting is in the draft. Apply it to restore the server settings.
states.restored: Previous setting restored. Test the server again.
